title: An investigation into the state of corvid–human relations
summary: This Audubon magazine article investigates the complex and nuanced relationship between crows (corvids) and humans, exploring whether crows can truly be considered friends to people. The article examines scientific research and observations about crow intelligence, memory, and behavior toward humans.
problem_solved: Understanding the nature and authenticity of human-crow relationships and crow intelligence
why_valuable: Provides scientific insight into corvid cognition and the mutual benefits of human-crow interactions, promoting better understanding of urban wildlife
